verdict.line: You lose if you get silenced by Decisive Strike mid-dash or stand still under his level-6 execute threat; you win by poking from max range and banking the pre-6 tempo lead before his ultimate comes online.

brief.thesis: Jayce's ranged poke and leap give him real lane control before level 6, matching the 50% head-to-head over 2,134 games and his edge in lane pressure and solo kills. The structural threat is Garen's R (Demacian Justice), a 400-range execute attempt on a long cooldown (140/110/80/50/20s) that flips any extended trade once he hits 6, so the matchup is even overall rather than free.

theirWindow.when: Garen's Q (Decisive Strike) is off cooldown
theirWindow.what: He gains a burst of Move Speed that breaks free of any slow and his next hit silences you. Don't leap in with Q (To the Skies!) expecting your slow to stick, and don't walk into auto range where the silence can eat your E (Thundering Blow) follow-up.

yourWindow.when: his Q (Decisive Strike) is down and you're pre-6
yourWindow.what: He has no gap-closer and no execute yet, so poke freely with Cannon stance Q (Shock Blast) or dive with Hammer stance Q (To the Skies!) into E (Thundering Blow) to knock him off you before resetting to range.

start.why: The 95.4% pick rate and 49.8% win rate over 2,503 games confirm this is the standard start for sustaining the early poke war before his Perseverance regen catches up.

boots.why: Highest-winrate boots at 51.7% over 915 games, the lower cooldowns let you reset Q (To the Skies!/Shock Blast) and R stance-swaps faster to keep poking between his Decisive Strike windows.

core.why: Builds mana for sustained Q spam and feeds Muramana scaling, part of the 57.6% win rate path over 311 games.
The active haste lets you catch a silenced retreat or reposition the instant his Q (Decisive Strike) resolves.
Converts your mana pool into the burst damage that punishes him before his R threshold matters.
Completes the highest-winrate build path and adds the burst needed to force a trade before Demacian Justice is up again.

his autoattack damage from Judgment and passive trading starts outpacing your lead

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards the hit-and-run poke pattern this lane demands: land a spell plus an attack, get the Move Speed burst, and kite out of Judgment range before he can close with Decisive Strike.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite carries the highest measured win rate (51%, 50.1% pick) and converts your pre-6 lane pressure into the solo kills this matchup already favors, while also denying his Perseverance regen between trades.

playing.title: Push the level 3 spike
playing.detail: Max Q early and use the single point in E (Thundering Blow) to establish lane control before he hits 3, matching the measured tip to apply pressure before his power spike.

playing.title: Respect Decisive Strike up close
playing.detail: Never leap in with Q (To the Skies!) while his Q is available; the Move Speed burst breaks your slow and the silence on his next hit shuts down your E follow-up.

playing.title: Track his R timer after 6
playing.detail: Demacian Justice has a long cooldown at rank 1 (140s) but drops fast (110/80/50/20s); don't stand still at low health inside his 400 range once he's level 6.

playing.title: Poke through Acceleration Gate
playing.detail: Deploy E (Acceleration Gate) and fire Q (Shock Blast) through it to extend its range, speed, and damage, letting you harass from outside his 325-range Judgment spin.

playing.title: Follow the 57.6% build order
playing.detail: Rush Tear of the Goddess into Youmuu's Ghostblade, Muramana, and Voltaic Cyclosword to keep your poke scaling ahead of his flat bruiser damage.

playing.title: Stance-swap to disengage
playing.detail: Use R to flip between Mercury Cannon and Mercury Hammer when he closes distance; the first attack after swapping to Cannon form shreds his Armor and Magic Resist for extra trade value.

playing.title: Never give him a free regen window
playing.detail: Keep landing W (Lightning Field) ticks and autos during extended trades so his Perseverance passive never triggers between engagements.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoner spells, and all win rates above are measured from live games on the current patch (16.19.1) via OP.GG; the mechanical breakdown and trade-pattern advice are my own reading of the ability kits.

stats.opponentTip: Although you can gain lane control by applying pressure before reaching level 3, Garen can use his ultimate to fight back. Keep some distance from him.
